name: Keeper Declan

intro.text: Fáilte! Welcome to Dublin. You came all the way over on the boat for this? Fair play to you.
Kin creatures are the everyday ones. Hares, cattle, ponies. Everyday doesn't mean easy. Let's go!

win: Ah, you're well able. Take the Kin Stone, you've earned every bit of it.
after: Go and get a bowl of something warm. Doctor's orders. I'm not a doctor.
